انضربوا (form VII)
# اِنْضَرَبُوا (inḍarabū) /in.dˤa.ra.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
# اِنْضَرِبُوا (inḍaribū) /in.dˤa.ri.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
